title: Using ChatGPT for long term trading
author: Capital-Singer563
selftext: I’ve started using chatGPT to help me pick stocks on trading212 (a more long term look on things). I’ve tried to be strategic about it by persistently working with it to attempt to make it better, long story short am I wasting my time? I understand I cannot just ask him to pick me stocks but I assume having basically an all knowing analyst is going to help me especially if I have half a brain, right?
